data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement merge-to-main-pr.sh foundation: PR creation via gh pr create, auto-merge queuing, CI polling loop with timeout, CONFLICT_DATA schema compatibility, and duplicate-PR guard.
**Why**: Foundation for the PR-mode merge path; unblocks thread resolution (S3b) and CONFLICT_DATA verification (S7).
**Scope**:
- IN: gh pr create invocation; gh pr merge --auto queuing; CI polling at 30s cadence (configurable); parallel gh api call per poll iteration for CI conclusions; max-wait timeout (configurable, default 60 min) with circuit breaker on permanent failure; duplicate-PR guard (detects existing open PR for same branch); script exits 0 after merge commit lands verified via git log origin/main; CONFLICT_DATA schema on conflict (same schema as merge-to-main-direct.sh); gh CLI version check for GraphQL support
- OUT: Thread resolution via GraphQL (S3b); Ruleset knob provisioning (S5); onboarding defaults (S6)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, merge-to-main-pr.sh creates a PR via gh pr create, queues gh pr merge --auto, and polls CI at 30s cadence (configurable)
  <- Satisfies: "Running merge-to-main.sh with merge.strategy=pr against the live digital-service-orchestra repo creates a PR via gh pr create, queues gh pr merge --auto, polls CI"
- When this story is complete, each poll iteration fetches CI check conclusions in one parallel gh api call
  <- Satisfies: "polls CI plus threads"
- When this story is complete, the wait loop has a max-wait timeout (configurable, default 60 min); on timeout the loop fails with a clear error message and the PR URL
  <- Satisfies: implied by scenario analysis (PR-mode wait loop spins indefinitely)
- When this story is complete, script detects an existing open PR for the same branch and fails with a clear error rather than creating a duplicate PR
  <- Satisfies: implied by scenario analysis (concurrent worktree sessions create duplicate PRs)
- When this story is complete, script exits 0 after the merge commit lands on origin/main, verified via git log origin/main showing the merge commit
  <- Satisfies: "exits zero after the merge commit lands on origin/main"
- When this story is complete, script emits CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema as merge-to-main-direct.sh on merge conflict
  <- Satisfies: "merge-to-main-direct.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh both emit CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema on conflict"
- When this story is complete, script exits 1 with clear error message when gh CLI version lacks GraphQL support
  <- Satisfies: implied by scenario analysis (version mismatch causes opaque failure)
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Security] gh token requires repo scope for PR creation and auto-merge
- [Reliability] Max-wait timeout prevents infinite spin on permanently broken CI check
- [Testing] GitHub API calls must use a mock-compatible interface pattern for unit testing

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a plugin maintainer, merge-to-main-pr.sh creates a PR and triggers auto-merge with CI polling
